registration.intro: Choose the 10K, 5K, or mile fun run, then complete registration through the official RunSignup page. Current listed prices include RunSignup fees.
registration.deadline: Registration ends October 2, 2026 at 9:00 PM EDT for all three events
registration.price_note: Current listed prices are $48.70 for the 10K, $38.10 for the 5K, and $22.20 for the mile fun run, including RunSignup fees.

runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to Strawberry Plains.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for shirts, awards, hydration, parking, and race-day rules.

items.label: Shirt deadline
items.detail: All 5K and 10K registrants receive a custom event T-shirt if registered before September 21, 2026. Mile participants can add a shirt for $12 before the same deadline.

items.label: Awards
items.detail: Age-group awards for the 5K and 10K are awarded in 10-year increments. Kids receive a special finisher gift after the mile run.

items.label: Water stops
items.detail: Water-only aid stations are available around miles 1 and 3, with restrooms near the start, finish, and registration area.

items.label: Parking plan
items.value: Church west lot and Rush Strong School
items.detail: Parking is available on the west side of the church lot and behind Rush Strong School; the east side of the church lot is reserved for the finish area.

items.label: Course rules
items.detail: Walkers are encouraged to use the mile or 5K, runners only for the 10K, strollers only in the mile, and no pets are allowed in any event.

items.label: Refund policy
items.detail: The official refund policy states that refunds are not allowed for this race.

course.description: The 5K is an out-and-back route with about 150 feet of elevation gain. The 10K is a looped Big Bend route with less than 250 feet of gain. Both start near Old Dandridge Pike and Old Andrew Johnson Highway and finish in the east portion of the church parking lot.

story.title: A fall race morning built around community support.
paragraphs: Around the Bend Five & Ten brings runners and families to Strawberry Plains for 10K, 5K, and mile options on the Big Bend route east of Knoxville.

Proceeds support First Baptist Church of Strawberry Plains and the Blessing Box, a free year-round food pantry for neighbors who are hungry and in need. A portion of the proceeds also supports Tennessee Endurance and local running opportunities.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: Race staging is at First Baptist Church Strawberry Plains, 3100 W Old Andrew Johnson Highway, Strawberry Plains, TN 37871.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: Around the Bend offers a 10K run, a 5K run/walk, and a 1-mile fun run.

faqs.question: When do the races start?
faqs.answer: The mile fun run starts at 7:30 AM EDT. The 5K and 10K start at 8:00 AM EDT.

faqs.question: Are strollers or pets allowed?
faqs.answer: Strollers are allowed only in the mile run/walk. Pets are not allowed in any event.

faqs.question: Are there restrooms and water stops?
faqs.answer: Restrooms are available near start, finish, and registration. Water-only stops are available around miles 1 and 3.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: Refunds are not allowed for this race.
